{{Enemy description|A quillbeast infected by active Originium dust. The creature's spines are imbued with high levels of energy, making them extremely destructive.}}

==Overview==
Imbued Quillbeasts are Quillbeasts that have been infected by Originium. While they retain most of the abilities of their normal relatives, they also have unique abilities as well:

*Claws twice in a row, dealing Physical damage.
*Rolls to either left or right, dealing Physical damage, but makes it immobile for a short period.
*Swings their tail around, dealing Physical damage and knock Operators back. This is followed with a tail slam, dealing Physical damage and knock Operators back at front.
*Bounce around three times, dealing Physical damage and knock Operators back in a larger area. This ability can be interrupted by skills.
*Enters Enraged state and rush forward before ending with a fall, dealing Physical damage and knock Operators back, with the fall having a larger area. This ability can be interrupted by skills.
